title: Daniel Grioli - Thinking like a Fox (S2E1)

reader_summary.headline: And if you'd like to learn more about Newfound's platform of ReturnStacked mutual funds, ETFs, and model portfolios.
reader_summary.overview: And if you'd like to learn more about Newfound's platform of ReturnStacked mutual funds, ETFs, and model portfolios, head over toreturnstacks.com. All right, three, two, one, let's do it. My guest in this episode is Daniel Grioli.

key_points.text: Daniel cut his teeth in the industry at Deutsche Bank in London.
key_points.evidence_quote: Daniel cut his teeth in the industry at Deutsche Bank in London, where he was responsible for valuing structured equity and hedge fund to fund products targeted at continental Europe.

key_points.text: His timing of joining Deutsche, while perhaps somewhat unfortunate for him.
key_points.evidence_quote: His timing of joining Deutsche, while perhaps somewhat unfortunate for him, proves fortunate for us as he retells a few war stories and lessons learned from the desk leading into 2008.

key_points.text: During the crisis, Daniel found himself back in Australia working for a pension fund where he made a career in manager evaluation, selection, selection.
key_points.evidence_quote: During the crisis, Daniel found himself back in Australia working for a pension fund where he made a career in manager evaluation, selection, selection, and combination.

key_points.text: That makes Daniel somewhat unique among prior podcast guests.
key_points.evidence_quote: That makes Daniel somewhat unique among prior podcast guests, as he provides us some insight into the decision-making of capital allocators on the other side of the table.
